EPIC PLAN REVIEW #6 -> PASS (0 blocking, 3 advisory) after six passes. Attestation certified at sha 1bed2f0cd, signed_at 1785294562818529000.
Applied 2 of 3 pass-6 advisories: ADV1 (G3/G4 — J2 deferred the reciprocal jira_datacenter import check to J7 but J7 had NO such AC; added it to J7) and ADV3 (T7 — J8's operator-doc AC omitted the new resolved_statuses and ca_bundle keys; added). Skipped ADV2 (P6 generic, no specific defect).
SEQUENCING ERROR + LESSON: applying those child edits IMMEDIATELY invalidated the epic attestation -> 'stale-pin-drift: reviewed related-ticket material is stale', so the claim was refused. A plan review PINS its children's material, so ANY child edit after the epic review staleness the epic. Correct order, which I am now following: finalize ALL child descriptions FIRST, then review bottom-up in dependency order (children before the epic, per AGENTS.md 'Review dependencies FIRST'), with the epic reviewed LAST and claimed immediately after. No child text edits after that point without re-reviewing the epic.
